# Wallet Recovery Agent

> Your operative on the inside. AI-led case assessment, human-led crypto wallet recovery.
> No recovery, no fee.

Wallet Recovery Agent helps people recover lost, locked, or corrupted cryptocurrency
wallets — seed phrases, forgotten passwords, hardware wallets (Ledger, Trezor),
MetaMask, Trust Wallet, and exchange lockouts. Cases begin with a private AI-agent
interview that qualifies the situation, then hand off to senior human operatives.

- [Talk to Agent](/assessment): Start a free private case assessment.
- [About](/about): Who the operatives are and why we can be trusted.
- [Contact](/contact): Direct contact channels.

## Safety
Wallet Recovery Agent NEVER asks for full seed phrases or private keys during
assessment. Any service that does is a scam.
